csv_project_name: Consultant for HVAC Pilot Property Condition Assessment
csv_scope_of_work: Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency (SHRA) is seeking qualified consulting firms to submit proposals for conducting a Property Condition Assessment and developing a Capital Improvement Plan for HVAC systems across all SHRA-owned and managed residential properties. This project will support long-term asset management, capital planning, and preventive maintenance. Final assessments and reports must be organized in formats that allow SHRA to distribute results easily by region.

short_description: Consulting services for HVAC condition assessments and capital improvement planning across housing properties.
project_scope: Property condition assessment and capital improvement plan development for HVAC systems across all Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency owned and managed residential properties. services: Consulting services for HVAC property condition assessments, capital improvement planning, inspection, cost estimating, planning/master planning, analytical/testing, hazardous waste engineering, electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, and civil engineering support.
relevance_explanation:
- The tender is focused on HVAC systems and property condition assessment, not structural engineering.
- It is primarily an MEP/building services assignment, which is explicitly not relevant for sbp.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure component is described.
- No structural design, object planning, or engineering of load-bearing systems is requested.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice concerns assessment and planning for HVAC systems across multiple residential properties, but provides no portfolio size, building areas, system quantities, or budget figures that would allow a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because the scope is an HVAC assessment and capital planning consultancy rather than a structural engineering assignment, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms for property condition assessment and capital improvement planning of HVAC systems; requested disciplines include civil engineering, cost estimating, inspection services, planning/master planning, analytical/testing services, hazardous waste engineering, electrical engineering, energy engineering, and mechanical engineering.
